scope: Active OpenTUI workspace, rendered surfaces, overlays, sidebar mouse controls, and CLI command entry points.

summary.counting_unit: One control record is one observable user action or one homogeneous set of aliases exercised through the same handler.

status_definitions.covered: A native OpenTUI or command-flow test asserts the user-visible result.
status_definitions.partial: Related helpers or part of the UI flow are tested, but the complete visible interaction is not.
status_definitions.uncovered: No behavior test currently drives this control.

Generic ListTab behavior is shared by Library, Inbox, Downloads, Meetings, Teams, Tools, Monitors, and Setup catalog lists.
CLI command parsing/dispatch is covered separately by cli.dispatch.test.ts, cli.init.test.ts, cli.node.test.ts, cli.kind.test.ts, and cli.api.test.ts.
Every registered CLI slash action has a rendered Chat flow test; parser usage/unknown handling is covered by commands.test.ts.

reconciliation.evidence: Granular current production callers reviewed against test assertions; historical capability rows retain partial status where their constituent controls remain undriven. Readback is the required outcome of a mutation action, not another counted user control.
